Helmut Hasse demostró la cota del número: Helmut Hasse proved the bound on the number of points in 1933. Neal Koblitz and Victor Miller proposed curves for cryptography in 1985, René Schoof gave the algorithm for counting points the same year, and for twenty years they were considered exotic: patents and the lack of standards held back their use. The NSA recommended them in 2005, Daniel Bernstein published Curve25519 that year with every design decision explained, and in the 2010s they became the de facto standard for key exchange and signatures.
